senses.gloss: m. (next w.) breaking, smashing.—Pl. constr. פִּתְפּוּתֵי, פִּי׳, only in פ׳ בצים mashed eggs, a phrase for confusion.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5:3">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite> <he>פ׳ ב׳ יש כאן</he> there is a confusion (of names) here; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 11:5:4">Y. Snh. XI, 30ᵇ</cite> bot.
